description: A botanical collector involves his nephew in a kidnapping to break a trust fund, then murders him to finance his hobby.

description: The mistress of a conductor becomes a target for murder after threatening to tell all to her lover's wife.

description: Columbo journeys to London to observe Scotland Yard, but winds up investigating murders committed by two Shakespearean actors.

description: A surgeon kills a nurse who suspects him of intentionally botching the heart surgery of his colleague, a cardiac expert.

description: An American chess champion plays a private match with his challenger and kills him because the man is a better player.

description: A senatorial candidate exploits death threats, fabricated for publicity, to kill his manager.

description: A motivational researcher blackmails to further his career, kills a man, then frames the victim's wife.

description: An enraged publisher hires a gunman to kill an author who intends to sign a contract with a competitor.

description: A prodigy and his robot help investigate the murder of a professor who threatened to disgrace a colleague's scientist son.

description: A gospel singer kills his evangelist wife when she denies him more money and threatens blackmail.

description: A man murders his wife and has a friend cover up the act with a burglary, only to have the friend blackmail him into doing the same favor in return.

description: Lt. Columbo keeps a close watch on a physical-fitness fanatic suspected of murdering his business partner.

description: A prominent photographer hatches a scheme to cover up his wife's murder with a phony kidnapping plot.

description: A military-academy commandant murders to protect his career and prevent his school's conversion to a coed junior college.

description: Columbo's Mexico cruise is disrupted when an automobile executive kills his blackmailing lover, the ship's singer, then frames a musician.

description: A psychiatrist (George Hamilton) romances a wealthy patient (Lesley Ann Warren) then uses her in his alibi after killing her husband (Stephen Elliott).

description: A retired actress/dancer stages her wealthy husband's suicide after he refuses to finance her Broadway comeback.

title: Columbo
description: A foreign dignitary murders his rival then disguises the crime as part of a robbery blamed on college protesters.

title: Columbo
description: A cunning advertising consultant leading a double life as a spy tries to cover up the details of a homicide.
